'''Mitsuaki Madono''' (Japanese: '''真殿光昭''' ''Madono Mitsuaki'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Madono was born on July 28, 1964 in {{wp|Osaka|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Madono started out voicing [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] during {{aniseries|OS}} and {{aniseries|DP}}, respectively. He was given a recurring role in {{aniseries|BW}} as [[Freddy O'Martian]], and would gain his most prominent role as {{an|Faba}} in {{aniseries|SM}}. Madono is currently affiliated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
